The gate recorded both pinned compiler inputs, a clean production build and package, rejection of the 0.33.0.0 reference, extraction of a baseline-compiled probe, and refusal of write, rename, and delete operations on the held copy.
A read-only Push-Location check confirmed that PowerShell and the process current directory selected different same-named Info.json files with different hashes.
Verified all 11 exported evidence hashes against their Git blobs. The retained build, published-package validation, and four-profile static audit identify the same production DLL digest.

findings.actual: The runner checks the argument with Test-Path -LiteralPath. The new helper then passes the original string to System.IO.File.Copy, which resolves it against the process current directory. The previous Copy-Item -LiteralPath used the caller's PowerShell location. Both handoff fixtures supply absolute paths.
findings.blocking_rationale: A valid relative invocation can fail or silently validate and stage another worktree's same-named ZIP. The recorded digest then identifies the wrong candidate for that run.
findings.expected: The existence check, copy, validation, and extraction all use the ZIP selected from the caller's PowerShell location.
findings.requested_correction: Resolve the supplied literal path to its absolute filesystem path before passing it to File.Copy.
findings.requested_evidence: Use a relative ZIP name in a disposable fixture whose PowerShell location differs from the process current directory. Verify that the held digest and extracted DLL match the selected package.
findings.title: A relative product ZIP can resolve to another worktree's archive
findings.trigger: Invoke the runner directly from a PowerShell session after changing directory and supply a relative -ProductZip.

findings.actual: The positive case packages $genuine, compiled at line 140 from the small Probe class. It compares the extracted DLL with that probe. The separate package-provenance suite builds and validates the production ZIP but never passes it to the handoff helper.
findings.blocking_rationale: The gate establishes that a baseline-compiled fixture reaches extraction. The requested observation for the actual Cutscene Skip package remains outstanding.
findings.expected: The genuine production ZIP reaches the same preflight and extraction boundary exercised by the refusal case.
findings.requested_correction: Pass the ZIP from the existing clean production packaging case through Open-ValidatedProductZip and Expand-ValidatedProductZip in the fixture.
findings.requested_evidence: Record a candidate-bound passing case that matches the held ZIP and extracted production DLL to the package manifest. Retain the specific 0.33.0.0 refusal.
findings.title: Only the probe DLL was observed at the ZIP handoff
findings.trigger: Inspect the positive control reported as a genuine baseline package handoff.

findings.actual: The failure fixture supplies missing-validator.ps1. Open-ValidatedProductZip throws before the validator runs and cleans up internally. The successful case closes its own handle in a test finally. Both cases would pass if the runner's setup catch omitted cleanup.
findings.blocking_rationale: Source inspection shows the original failure site is now covered. The gate still lacks the requested observation that cleanup runs after ownership of the validated archive transfers to the caller.
findings.expected: A fixture admits a valid ZIP, forces a later setup error, and observes the caller's cleanup of the acquired resource.
findings.requested_correction: Exercise the runner's package cleanup path in a disposable fixture with a setup failure after Open-ValidatedProductZip returns successfully.
findings.requested_evidence: Show successful validation, the intended later setup error, and an empty fixture work folder or released input handle. Keep the test independent of the native transaction.
findings.title: The cleanup failure fixture stops before validation succeeds
findings.trigger: Evaluate cleanup when setup fails after a valid ZIP has been handed to the caller.

prior_finding_assessments.rationale: The negative case now checks the underlying 0.33.0.0 diagnostic. The passing extraction compares a generated Probe DLL with itself after handoff. The production ZIP was observed only at standalone validation.

The package tests call the real ZIP helper in fixture-owned directories. Even unexpected admission ends inside the fixture. The runner is read as text, so the test cannot acquire the native lock or launch Kingmaker.

The validator reads the copy while a FileShare.Read handle protects it. Hashing and extraction consume that handle. The gate confirmed refusal of writes, rename, and deletion through extraction. R10-F1 concerns selection of the source before that protection begins.

The runner now calls cleanup if evidence or backup directory creation throws. The submitted failure test exercises the helper before handoff, leaving the explicitly requested post-validation failure observation open.

summary.delivered_behavior: Cutscene Skip declares UMM 0.31.1 and builds against UnityModManager 0.31.1.0 and 0Harmony12 1.2.0.1. Packaging checks the shipped manifest, DLL references, and build receipt. Once the ZIP helper selects a file, it protects the validated bytes through extraction.
